',alt:'Crispy KFC style fried chicken',veg:false,variants:[{label:'4 Pieces',price:160},{label:'8 Pieces',price:320}],nutrition:[{kcal:880,p:52,f:48,c:55},{kcal:1760,p:104,f:96,c:110}]},
      {id:'nuggets',cat:'chicken',name:'Chicken Nuggets',note:'With french fries',img:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',alt:'Chicken nuggets with french fries',veg:false,variants:[{label:'4 Pieces',price:140},{label:'8 Pieces',price:280}],nutrition:[{kcal:480,p:18,f:24,c:46},{kcal:960,p:36,f:48,c:92}]},
      {id:'cheese-fries',cat:'chicken',name:'Cheese Fries',note:'Loaded with cheese',img:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',alt:'Cheese loaded fries',veg:true,variants:[{label:'8 Pieces',price:120}],nutrition:[{kcal:450,p:10,f:24,c:48}]},
      {id:'popcorn',cat:'chicken',name:'Chicken Popcorns',note:'Bite-size & crunchy',img:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',alt:'Chicken popcorn in a bowl',veg:false,variants:[{label:'8 Pieces',price:150},{label:'16 Pieces',price:300}],nutrition:[{kcal:380,p:22,f:18,c:30},{kcal:760,p:44,f:36,c:60}]}
    ];
    var FREE_ABOVE=299, DELIVERY_FEE=40, PHONE_WA='919389056818';
    var cart={};           // key: itemId|variantLabel -> qty
    var selectedVariant={}; // itemId -> variant index
    var mode='delivery';
    var byId={}; MENU.forEach(function(m){byId[m.id]=m; selectedVariant[m.id]=0;});
    var reduceMotion=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    function rs(n){return '₹'+n;}
    function cartCount(){var c=0;for(var k in cart)c+=cart[k];return c;}
    function cartSubtotal(){var s=0;for(var k in cart){var p=k.split('|');var item=byId[p[0]];var v=item.variants.filter(function(x){return x.label===p[1];})[0];if(v)s+=v.price*cart[k];}return s;}
    function deliveryFee(){if(mode==='pickup')return 0;var s=cartSubtotal();return s===0?0:(s>=FREE_ABOVE?0:DELIVERY_FEE);}

    /* ---------- Render menu cards ---------- */
    function nutritionHtml(item,idx){
      var n=item.nutrition && item.nutrition[idx];
      if(!n) return '';
      var portion=item.variants[idx].label;
      return '<div class="nutrition" aria-label="Nutrition approx for '+portion+'"><div class="nutrition-head"><b>Nutrition · approx</b><span>'+portion+'</span></div><div class="nutri-grid"><div><strong>'+n.kcal+'</strong><span>kcal</span></div><div class="protein"><strong>'+n.p+'g</strong><span>Protein</span></div><div><strong>'+n.f+'g</strong><span>Fat</span></div><div><strong>'+n.c+'g</strong><span>Carbs</span></div></div></div>';
    }
    function buildCard(item){
      var card=document.createElement('article');
      card.className='card'; card.setAttribute('data-cat',item.cat); card.setAttribute('data-id',item.id); card.setAttribute('data-veg',item.veg?'veg':'nonveg');
      var variantsHtml='';
      if(item.variants.length>1){
        variantsHtml='<div class="variants" role="group" aria-label="Choose portion size">'+item.variants.map(function(v,i){
          return '<button type="button" class="variant" data-var="'+i+'" aria-pressed="'+(i===0)+'">'+v.label+' · '+rs(v.price)+'</button>';
        }).join('')+'</div>';
      } else {
        variantsHtml='<div class="variants"><span class="variant" aria-pressed="true" style="cursor:default">'+item.variants[0].label+'</span></div>';
      }
      var dietBadge = item.veg
        ? '<span class="diet-badge is-veg" title="Vegetarian"><span class="mark" aria-hidden="true"></span>VEG</span>'
        : '<span class="diet-badge is-nonveg" title="Non-vegetarian"><span class="mark" aria-hidden="true"></span>NON-VEG</span>';
      var tagHtml = item.tag ? '<span class="card-tag">'+item.tag+'</span>' : '';
      card.innerHTML=
        '<div class="card-img"><img src="'+item.img+'" alt="'+item.alt+'" loading="eager" decoding="async" />'+dietBadge+tagHtml+'</div>'+
        '<div class="card-body"><span class="corner-initials" style="font-size:2.6rem;right:8px;bottom:6px" aria-hidden="true">DC</span><h3>'+item.name+'</h3><p class="card-note">'+item.note+'</p>'+variantsHtml+
        '<div class="nutrition-wrap">'+nutritionHtml(item,0)+'</div>'+
        '<div class="card-foot"><span class="price">'+rs(item.variants[0].price)+'</span><span class="card-action"></span></div></div>';
      var priceEl=card.querySelector('.price');
      var nutriWrap=card.querySelector('.nutrition-wrap');
      card.querySelectorAll('.variant[data-var]').forEach(function(btn){
        btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
          var idx=parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-var'),10);
          selectedVariant[item.id]=idx;
          card.querySelectorAll('.variant').forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b===btn));});
          priceEl.textContent=rs(item.variants[idx].price);
          if(nutriWrap) nutriWrap.innerHTML=nutritionHtml(item,idx);
          renderCardAction(card,item);
        });
      });
      renderCardAction(card,item);
      return card;
    }
    function renderCardAction(card,item){
      var slot=card.querySelector('.card-action');
      var v=item.variants[selectedVariant[item.id]];
      var key=item.id+'|'+v.label;
      var qty=cart[key]||0;
      if(qty===0){
        slot.innerHTML='<button type="button" class="add-btn">ADD +</button>';
        slot.querySelector('.add-btn').addEventListener('click',function(){ setQty(key,1); });
      } else {
        slot.innerHTML='<span class="stepper"><button type="button" data-d="-1" aria-label="Remove one">−</button><span class="qty">'+qty+'</span><button type="button" data-d="1" aria-label="Add one">+</button></span>';
        slot.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){
          b.addEventListener('click',function(){ setQty(key, qty + parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-d'),10)); });
        });
      }
    }
    function refreshAllCardActions(){
      document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(function(card){
        var item=byId[card.getAttribute('data-id')];
        if(item) renderCardAction(card,item);
      });
    }
    MENU.forEach(function(item){
      var grid=document.querySelector('[data-grid="'+item.cat+'"]');
      if(grid) grid.appendChild(buildCard(item));
    });

    /* ---------- Cart logic ---------- */
    var cartbar=document.getElementById('cartbar'), cbCount=document.getElementById('cbCount'),
        cbTotal=document.getElementById('cbTotal'), cbHint=document.getElementById('cbHint'),
        sheet=document.getElementById('sheet'), backdrop=document.getElementById('backdrop'),
        cartLines=document.getElementById('cartLines'), emptyCart=document.getElementById('emptyCart'),
        billWrap=document.getElementById('billWrap');
    function setQty(key,qty){
      if(qty<=0) delete cart[key]; else cart[key]=qty;
      updateCartUI(); refreshAllCardActions();
    }
    function updateCartUI(){
      var count=cartCount(), sub=cartSubtotal(), fee=deliveryFee(), total=sub+fee;
      cbCount.textContent=count+(count===1?' item':' items');
      cbTotal.textContent=rs(sub);
      cbHint.textContent = mode==='delivery' ? (sub>=FREE_ABOVE ? 'FREE delivery unlocked' : (count? 'Add '+rs(FREE_ABOVE-sub)+' more for FREE delivery' : '')) : 'Pickup · no delivery charge';
      cartbar.classList.toggle('show',count>0);
      cartbar.setAttribute('aria-hidden',String(count===0));
      // sheet
      cartLines.innerHTML='';
      Object.keys(cart).forEach(function(key){
        var p=key.split('|'), item=byId[p[0]];
        var v=item.variants.filter(function(x){return x.label===p[1];})[0];
        var qty=cart[key];
        var line=document.createElement('div'); line.className='cart-line';
        line.innerHTML='<div><h4>'+item.name+'</h4><small>'+p[1]+' · '+rs(v.price)+'</small></div>'+
          '<span class="mini-stepper"><button type="button" data-d="-1" aria-label="Remove one">−</button><span class="qty">'+qty+'</span><button type="button" data-d="1" aria-label="Add one">+</button></span>'+
          '<span class="line-total">'+rs(v.price*qty)+'</span>';
        line.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){
          b.addEventListener('click',function(){ setQty(key, qty + parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-d'),10)); });
        });
        cartLines.appendChild(line);
      });
      emptyCart.style.display=count?'none':'block';
      billWrap.style.display=count?'block':'none';
      document.getElementById('billSub').textContent=rs(sub);
      document.getElementById('billDelRow').style.display = mode==='delivery' ? 'flex':'none';
      document.getElementById('billDel').innerHTML = fee===0 && sub>0 ? '<span class="free-tag">FREE</span>' : rs(fee);
      document.getElementById('billTotal').textContent=rs(total);
      var hint=document.getElementById('freeHint');
      if(mode==='delivery' && count && sub<FREE_ABOVE){ hint.style.display='block'; hint.textContent='Add '+rs(FREE_ABOVE-sub)+' more and delivery becomes FREE (orders above ₹299).'; }
      else if(mode==='delivery' && count){ hint.style.display='block'; hint.textContent='You unlocked FREE delivery — this order is above ₹299.'; }
      else { hint.style.display='none'; }
      buildWhatsAppLink(sub,fee,total);
    }
    function buildWhatsAppLink(sub,fee,total){
      var lines=['Hello Doon Culture! I would like to order:'];
      Object.keys(cart).forEach(function(key){
        var p=key.split('|'), item=byId[p[0]];
        var v=item.variants.filter(function(x){return x.label===p[1];})[0];
        lines.push('• '+cart[key]+' × '+item.name+' ('+p[1]+') — '+rs(v.price*cart[key]));
      });
      lines.push('Subtotal: '+rs(sub));
      if(mode==='delivery'){ lines.push('Delivery: '+(fee===0?'FREE':rs(fee))); lines.push('Total: '+rs(total)); lines.push('Order type: Home Delivery'); }
      else { lines.push('Total: '+rs(total)); lines.push('Order type: Pickup'); }
      var name=document.getElementById('custName').value.trim();
      var addr=document.getElementById('custAddr').value.trim();
      if(name) lines.push('Name: '+name);
      if(addr && mode==='delivery') lines.push('Address: '+addr);
      document.getElementById('waOrder').href='https://wa.me/'+PHONE_WA+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(lines.join('\n'));
    }
    document.getElementById('custName').addEventListener('input',updateCartUI);
    document.getElementById('custAddr').addEventListener('input',updateCartUI);
    function setMode(m){
      mode=m;
      document.getElementById('modeDelivery').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(m==='delivery'));
      document.getElementById('modePickup').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(m==='pickup'));
      updateCartUI();
    }
    document.getElementById('modeDelivery').addEventListener('click',function(){setMode('delivery');});
    document.getElementById('modePickup').addEventListener('click',function(){setMode('pickup');});
    function openSheet(){ sheet.hidden=false; requestAnimationFrame(function(){ sheet.classList.add('show'); backdrop.classList.add('show'); }); document.getElementById('sheetClose').focus(); }
    function closeSheet(){ sheet.classList.remove('show'); backdrop.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(function(){ sheet.hidden=true; },360); }
    document.getElementById('cbOpen').addEventListener('click',openSheet);
    document.getElementById('sheetClose').addEventListener('click',closeSheet);
    backdrop.addEventListener('click',closeSheet);
    document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape' && !sheet.hidden) closeSheet(); });
    updateCartUI();

    /* ---------- Category + Veg/Non-Veg filter ---------- */
    var filters=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.filter'));
    var blocks=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.cat-block'));
    filters.forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
        var f=btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
        filters.forEach(function(b){ b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b===btn)); });
        var visible=[];
        blocks.forEach(function(block){
          var cards=Array.prototype.slice.call(block.querySelectorAll('.card'));
          var blockVisible=[];
          if(f==='all'){
            cards.forEach(function(c){ c.hidden=false; blockVisible.push(c); });
            block.style.display='';
          } else if(f==='veg' || f==='nonveg'){
            cards.forEach(function(c){
              var match=c.getAttribute('data-veg')===f;
              c.hidden=!match;
              if(match) blockVisible.push(c);
            });
            block.style.display=blockVisible.length?'':'none';
          } else {
            var show = block.getAttribute('data-block')===f;
            cards.forEach(function(c){ c.hidden=false; });
            block.style.display = show?'':'none';
            if(show) blockVisible=cards;
          }
          visible=visible.concat(blockVisible);
        });
        if(!reduceMotion && Element.prototype.animate){
          visible.forEach(function(card,i){
            card.animate([{opacity:0,transform:'translateY(18px) scale(.98)'},{opacity:1,transform:'translateY(0) scale(1)'}],{duration:420,delay:Math.min(i,10)*45,easing:'cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)',fill:'backwards'});
          });
        }
        var menuEl=document.getElementById('menu');
        if(menuEl) menuEl.scrollIntoView({behavior: reduceMotion?'auto':'smooth', block:'start'});
      });
    });

    /* ---------- Reveal on scroll ---------- */
    if(!reduceMotion && 'IntersectionObserver' in window && Element.prototype.animate){
      var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
        entries.forEach(function(en){
          if(!en.isIntersecting) return;
          en.target.animate([{opacity:0,transform:'translateY(24px)'},{opacity:1,transform:'translateY(0)'}],{duration:600,easing:'cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)',fill:'backwards'});
          io.unobserve(en.target);
        });
      },{threshold:.1});
      document.querySelectorAll('.cat-head,.info-card,.map-box,.reviews-in > div,.delivery-card').forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
    }

    /* ---------- Open-now status (Asia/Kolkata) ---------- */
    function updateStatus(){
      var now=new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US',{timeZone:'Asia/Kolkata'}));
      var mins=now.getHours()*60+now.getMinutes();
      var open = mins>=600 && mins<1350; // 10:00 AM – 10:30 PM
      var pill=document.getElementById('openStatus');
      pill.classList.toggle('closed',!open);
      pill.querySelector('.st-text').textContent = open ? 'Open now · till 10:30 PM' : 'Closed · opens 10:00 AM';
      document.getElementById('visitStatus').textContent = open ? 'Seven days a week — open right now, till 10:30 PM.' : 'Seven days a week — currently closed, opens 10:00 AM.';
    }
    updateStatus(); setInterval(updateStatus,60000);

    /* ---------- Map ---------- */
    var place={label:'Doon Culture',address:'Mehuwala, near Chauhan Colony, Mehuwala Mafi',locality:'Dehradun',region:'Uttarakhand',country:'IN',lat:30.30875976,lng:77.98305207};
    function showStaticMap(){
      document.getElementById('map').style.display='none';
      document.getElementById('mapFallback').classList.add('show');
    }
    try{
      if(window.MapHelpers){
        MapHelpers.mountMap(document.getElementById('map'),{places:[place],baseStyle:'light'},showStaticMap);
      } else { showStaticMap(); }
    }catch(e){ showStaticMap(); }

    /* ---------- Install app (Add to Home Screen) ---------- */
    var installWrap=document.getElementById('installWrap'),
        installCard=document.getElementById('installCard'),
        installCopy=document.getElementById('installCopy'),
        installBtnText=document.getElementById('installBtnText'),
        installSheet=document.getElementById('installSheet'),
        installBackdrop=document.getElementById('installBackdrop'),
        installTriggers=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.install-trigger'));
    function isStandalone(){
      try{ if(window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches) return true; }catch(e){}
      return window.navigator.standalone===true;
    }
    function isIOS(){ return /iphone|ipad|ipod/i.test(navigator.userAgent||''); }
    function markInstalled(){
      window.__dcDeferredPrompt=null;
      if(installCard) installCard.classList.add('installed');
      if(installBtnText) installBtnText.textContent='App Installed ✓';
      if(installCopy) installCopy.innerHTML='Badhaai ho! <b>Doon Culture app tumhare phone pe install ho gaya hai.</b> Home screen pe DC icon dabao — app wahi se full-screen khulega.';
    }
    function refreshInstallUI(){
      if(isStandalone()){
        // Launched from home screen: no need to pitch install again.
        if(installWrap) installWrap.style.display='none';
        installTriggers.forEach(function(b){ if(b.id!=='installBtn') b.style.display='none'; });
        return;
      }
      if(window.__dcDeferredPrompt && installBtnText) installBtnText.textContent='Install App — Free';
    }
    function openInstallSheet(){
      // Highlight the steps for this phone first.
      var a=document.getElementById('stepsAndroid'), i=document.getElementById('stepsIos');
      if(a && i){
        var active=isIOS()?i:a, other=isIOS()?a:i;
        active.style.borderColor='var(--red)'; active.style.borderWidth='1.5px';
        other.style.borderColor=''; other.style.borderWidth='';
        if(active.parentNode && active.parentNode.firstChild!==active) active.parentNode.insertBefore(active, active.parentNode.firstChild);
      }
      installSheet.hidden=false;
      requestAnimationFrame(function(){ installSheet.classList.add('show'); installBackdrop.classList.add('show'); });
      document.getElementById('installClose').focus();
    }
    function closeInstallSheet(){
      installSheet.classList.remove('show'); installBackdrop.classList.remove('show');
      setTimeout(function(){ installSheet.hidden=true; },360);
    }
    function handleInstallClick(){
      var dp=window.__dcDeferredPrompt;
      if(dp){
        dp['prompt']();
        var choice=dp.userChoice;
        window.__dcDeferredPrompt=null;
        if(choice && choice.then){
          choice.then(function(res){ if(res && res.outcome==='accepted') markInstalled(); else openInstallSheet(); });
        }
      } else {
        openInstallSheet();
      }
    }
    installTriggers.forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener('click',handleInstallClick); });
    document.getElementById('installClose').addEventListener('click',closeInstallSheet);
    installBackdrop.addEventListener('click',closeInstallSheet);
    document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape' && !installSheet.hidden) closeInstallSheet(); });
    document.addEventListener('dc-installable',refreshInstallUI);
    document.addEventListener('dc-installed',markInstalled);
    window.addEventListener('appinstalled',markInstalled);
    refreshInstallUI();

    /* Manifest fallback: if the hosted manifest file cannot load in this
       runtime, swap in an equivalent inline (blob) manifest built for
       the page's own URL, so name / icons / standalone mode still apply. */
    try{
      fetch('data:application/octet-stream;base64,',{method:'GET'}).then(function(r){
        if(r.ok) return;
        throw new Error('manifest not ok');
      }).catch(function(){
        try{
          var base=window.location.href.split('#')[0];
          var icon=function(p){ return new URL(p,base).href; };
          var mf={
            name:'Doon Culture', short_name:'Doon Culture', display:'standalone',
            theme_color:'#c43d2f', background_color:'#faf5ec',
            start_url:base, scope:base,
            icons:[
              {src:icon('data:image/png;base64,'),sizes:'192x192',type:'image/png',purpose:'any'},
              {src:icon('data:image/png;base64,'),sizes:'512x512',type:'image/png',purpose:'any'},
              {src:icon('data:image/png;base64,'),sizes:'192x192',type:'image/png',purpose:'maskable'},
              {src:icon('data:image/png;base64,'),sizes:'512x512',type:'image/png',purpose:'maskable'}
            ]
          };
          var blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(mf)],{type:'application/manifest+json'});
          document.getElementById('appManifest').href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        }catch(e){}
      });
    }catch(e){}
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
